n: Moroni had finished abridging the Jaredite record (the book of Ether) and expected that to be his last writing. Surprised to still be alive, he keeps hidden from the Lamanites, who would kill him if they found him.

f.w: the account of the people of Jared
I had supposed not to have written more

n: The Nephite nation has been destroyed, and now the Lamanites are fighting among themselves. Any surviving Nephite is given a terrible choice: deny Jesus Christ or die.

f.w: their wars are exceedingly fierce among themselves

n: Moroni refuses to deny the Savior, even though it means living as a lonely fugitive. His quiet courage is one of the great examples of faithfulness in all scripture.

So Moroni adds a few more chapters he never planned to write, hoping they will bless his former enemies’ descendants someday. His love for the Lamanites, the very people hunting him, reflects the Savior’s command to love our enemies.

f.w: of worth unto my brethren, the Lamanites
